samples.summaryVi: Điện thoại có ích khi có nhiệm vụ rõ; thông báo và luật dùng không rõ dễ gây xao nhãng.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to request further information about a digital learning workshop. I am interested in smartphones in the classroom and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích mình cần thông tin gì.

Ms Brown

a digital learning workshop

parts.text: . I am interested in
smartphones in the classroom
parts.labelVi: chủ đề

parts.text: and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.

paragraphs.template:
Dear [danh xưng và họ người nhận],

I am writing to request further information about [sự kiện / hoạt động]. I am interested in [chủ đề] and would appreciate your advice before making a decision. I would like to explain my situation and ask a few questions.

paragraphs.label: Nhu cầu
paragraphs.text: My main concern is that I have limited experience and would prefer a practical introduction. I understand that participants will try a phone-based research task and discuss classroom rules. This interests me because students can quickly access useful learning material. For example, a class can compare two digital maps to explain how a neighbourhood has changed.
